description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What Is This?
This is the Suzuki OEM Speedometer Gear Case, O-Ring & Oil Seal Kit
This is the Case that the Gear fits into in the Transfer Case Housing.
Includes Both O-Rings & Oil Seal!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Case, Speedometer Gear
Qty 1 – O-Ring (Outer)
Qty 1 – O-Ring (Inner)
Qty 1 – Oil Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
